newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ahmsa plans $200 mln power plant. [CORRECTED 21:57 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Ahmsa plans $200 mln power plant. [CORRECTED 21:57 GMT]

text.p: Mexican steelmaker Altos Hornos de Mexico (Ahmsa) said Thursday it was planning to invest $200 million in a coal-fired power plant in the northern state of Coahuila.
(Company corrects cost of plant from $250 million).

Ahmsa said the plant will be located in the town of Palau, in the municipality of Muzquiz, and will be built to meet its energy needs and those of subsidiaries Minera Carbonifera Rio Escondido, Minera del Norte and Minerales Monclova.

The plant will start operating in 1999 and initially will have two generators with capacity of 180 megawatts, "sufficient to cover the needs of Altos Hornos and its units," the company said in a statement.
